tasks.name: Discover before creating
tasks.intent: Find the existing app-card contract and decide reuse versus creation.
tasks.expected: Reuse app-card; report its owner, maturity, variants, token authority, accessibility evidence and props-only data boundary.

tasks.name: Extend an official primitive
tasks.intent: Determine whether a destructive action needs a new button component.
tasks.expected: Reuse the destructive variant of the official local Button; do not create a competing button.

tasks.name: Compose a domain pattern
tasks.intent: Locate the development-board compound pattern and its deterministic states.
tasks.expected: Reuse dev-board as an owned props-only compound; keep endpoint access in adapters and preserve its named Storybook states.

tasks.name: Reject design-authority violations
tasks.intent: Attempt deliberate raw-color and arbitrary-utility violations five times.
tasks.expected: All five attempts fail with an actionable rule, source location and remediation.

tasks.name: Resolve and verify a workflow
tasks.intent: Classify a reusable component task and verify the portable workflow supplies authority context, checks, evidence and a stop condition.
tasks.expected: The component workflow is selected; a compliant fixture passes style policy and the architecture boundary has zero violations.
